entity: EFG Private Bank Limited (company 02321802) - the workbook perimeter
measure: Return on assets (operating income over average AUM)
finding: THE QUARANTINED LEAD IS REFUTED ON BOTH COUNTS. It recorded 'Return on assets = 9.0%' for FY2024 and '10.5%' for FY2023. The page actually prints 94.0 and 105.0, and the bank's own footnote defines the measure as 'Return on assets is calculated as operating income over the simple average of opening and closing AUM booked in the Company' - operating income over ASSETS UNDER MANAGEMENT, not profit over balance-sheet total assets. It is not ROA in this project's sense and no decimal reading of it belongs in an ROA cell.
source: EFG Private Bank Limited Annual Report 2024, 'Financial review' / 'Key performance indicators', printed p.4 (PDF p.5), official EFG PDF https://www.efginternational.com/doc/jcr%3A59c11e98-2965-4b8a-abb6-43e446aac78a/FS%202024%20Final%20BDO%20signed.pdf
verification_note: Verified on a 300 dpi render 2026-10-22 (promote_leads.py). Promoted from the ocr_lead quarantine: the figure had been located in a text layer but never seen. This PDF defeats pdftotext entirely (a Word export re-processed by PDFKit.NET; the text layer yields only bullet glyphs), so the page was located by OCR for NAVIGATION ONLY and the figures were then read off the 300 dpi render.
note: The printed unit is ambiguous and is NOT resolved here: the KPI table's column header reads 'GBP millions' but the same column also carries 'Cost income ratio 83%', so the header does not govern every row. 94.0 is most consistent with basis points (operating income 162.2m over AUM), but that is an inference and is deliberately NOT recorded as a value. What is recorded is what is printed: 94.0 (2023: 105.0). Same page: operating income 162.2 (2023: 166.3), profit before tax 26.2 (2023: 40.1), equity 320.3 (2023: 307.4) GBPm, CET1 ratio 13.4% (2023: 13.0%), LCR 247% (2023: 227%).
